sound.title: Reminder sound
sound.description: What happens at prayer time while the app is open.

hints.adhan: Adhan recording at prayer time; chime for iqamah

sound.volumeHint: On iPhone the volume follows the side buttons.
sound.foregroundNote: While the app is open (even in another tab), the reminder fires right at the adhan time with the sound above and a Stop button. Browsers only allow sound after you have tapped the app once, so tap anywhere after opening it.
sound.backgroundNote: When the app is closed, your phone shows the notification with its standard notification sound. Browsers do not allow a custom sound such as the adhan for background notifications. On iPhone, notifications need the app added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).

alert.label: Prayer reminder
alert.blocked: Your browser blocked the sound. Tap Play adhan to hear it.
